_readme: Known-dangling references inside sot/*.md, recorded 2026-08-28. This file may only SHRINK. CI rejects any PR that adds an entry. Burn-down is Station 05's job: fix the reference in sot/, then delete its entry here in the same PR. See docs/pipeline/stations/05-sot-keeper.md. TRAP 1 (MEASURED 2026-08-28 @82ba8538, RE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-30 @4461c8be): check-sot-refs.mjs resolves with existsSync against the WORKING TREE, so an entry can read as 'already resolved' on a dev box purely because its target is a gitignored local artifact -- the dev tree printed '17 baselined' while a clean worktree off origin/main printed '23' at the same SHA. Measure in a clean worktree, and before deleting an entry for a target you believe now exists, prove it: git cat-file -e origin/main:<path>. THE STRUCTURAL FLOOR WAS 8 AND IS NOT A FLOOR (2026-08-30, Station 05). Entries whose target is gitignored by design, or is a queue prompt the -ready.md-only EXCLUDED_PATH_CLASSES does not cover, are NOT burned down by deleting the entry -- deleting alone turns each into a hard CI failure (measured negative control: 10 entries removed, no markers, dangling=10 exit 1). They move from baselined= to exempt= by writing an inline <!-- sot-ref-allow: reason --> marker on the sot/ line itself. ALLOW_COMMENT_RE (check-sot-refs.mjs:154) is matched against the sot/ file's own line and continues BEFORE the path-class check and BEFORE existsSync, so the marker is the only mechanism that can clear a reference whose target is correct but structurally absent from main. It is also line-drift-proof, which a line-number-keyed baseline entry is not. It is Station 05's alone to write, because it lives inside sot/. TRAP 2, and it is why sot/README.md:190 is still here (MEASURED 2026-08-30, PR #1405 CI run 33316687892): the ci.yml step 'sot-refs ratchet -- baseline may only shrink' greps git diff origin/main -- this file for '^+.*"missing_path"'. Deleting the LAST array element forces the new last element to drop its trailing comma, which the diff shows as a '+' line containing missing_path -- so a PR that REMOVED ten entries was rejected for 'gaining' one. check-sot-refs.mjs itself passed in the same run. Until that step counts entries instead of '+' lines, NEVER delete the last element: leave it and burn the interior. The other 13 entries are the real debt: every one needs a judgement call about a deleted doc or a moved source file, so none is auto-fixable.
